interpretation.statement: The reported access is inside the frozen upstream CPU decoder used as the HyperCine coefficient oracle, not inside HyperCine production decode. The load is an unconditional vector read-ahead in the SSE2 temporal inverse loop (_mm_load_si128 of the next iteration's low/high coefficients); on the final row of the plane the read-ahead passes the end of the plane allocation.
interpretation.effect_on_reference_values: NOT_PROVEN_TO_CHANGE_OUTPUT; the trace shows a read, not a write, and the existing frozen upstream hashes for the same fixtures still match in the non-ASan Release build
interpretation.explains_historical_heap_corruption: PLAUSIBLE_EXPLANATION_NOT_PROVEN; a 16-byte read past a heap allocation is exactly the kind of access that a CRT heap checker reports as heap corruption when the read lands on unmapped or checker-poisoned memory
interpretation.action: Documented as an upstream quirk in docs/UPSTREAM.md; upstream sources were not modified. HyperCine SIMD backends (#69/#70) must not imitate it.
